answer: Distinct-Origin Quorum Pricing. Each agent action must cite a set of independent origin attestations, and the fee scales with the largest share held by any single origin, so a sybil cluster pays superlinearly to reach quorum. A broad harbor of identities earns nothing extra; the cost sits on correlated origins. Honest agents spread across the river of independent roots pay near baseline. Attackers must fund many genuinely separate origins to reach any decision summit, making each effective identity cost far more than one real participant.
